answer: A workable defense binds each earning identity to a costly external anchor. An agent must prove control of a unique, verifiable anchor, such as a registered domain answering a signed challenge, and the protocol permits one earning identity per anchor. Registration recurs: each fake agent needs its own domain, renewal fees, and a DNS record, so a sybil farm becomes enumerable and cost grows linearly, not toward zero. Anchors expire, and an unrenewed one drops its identity to zero weight, forcing operators to wander back, bridge services, and tend reputation like a grove requiring replanting.
